new_agent_audits.name: libloading
new_agent_audits.who: NymWrap source review (Codex agent; not human)

machine_checked_files.method: Every line is empty, rustdoc, or an empty public module declaration; no executable Rust

new_agent_audits.notes: Read both manifests, README and all executable production Rust, including Unix and Windows implementations, exact platform constants, symbol/type helpers and errors. The changelog module was validated as documentation plus empty modules; historical prose is not a reviewed implementation. Unsafe library loading explicitly executes caller-selected native initializers/finalizers; symbol lookup and raw-handle conversion require correct ABI/type, ownership and lifetime proofs. The safe Symbol wrapper carries a borrow of its Library and clones preserve that borrow; pointer-sized type checks precede casts, and Send/Sync bounds on symbols follow T. C symbol names reject internal NUL and retain backing strings across FFI. Unix library acquisition checks null handles, dlerror is copied before another call, and close forgets ownership after a single close attempt. dlerror on older non-thread-local implementations retains documented concurrency limits; this is not a portability proof for nonconforming loaders. Windows acquires owning module references, uses explicit system ABI and checked success values, and reads only the reported initialized UTF-16 filename range. Its thread-local error-mode guard restores state on drop. Windows library filenames permit embedded-NUL truncation, so a caller must validate exact paths before using them as an allowlist boundary. Default loader search paths and environment are trusted local build/runtime configuration, not a sandbox for untrusted DLL names. No build script, bundled native payload, network API, telemetry or independent loading occurs without an explicit caller request. Loader/OS correctness, loaded libraries, their destructors and downstream use of unsafe APIs remain separate. Windows review checks exercise a preloaded system module and symbol lifetime/ABI handling; Unix and cross-target runtime tests were not run.

new_exemptions.name: async-broadcast
new_exemptions.notes: Проверено агентом, не человеком. set_capacity(0) with overflow=true allows the queue to exceed capacity. Reproduced in the synthetic review harness. No safe-to-deploy audit granted. Exact archive SHA-256 435a87a52755b8f27fcf321ac4f04b2802e337c8c4872923137471ec39c37532. Root-only non-reachability exception: these packages are reachable in Cargo metadata through keyring 3.6.3 -> optional secret-service 4.0.0 -> zbus 4.4.0, but root selects sync-secret-service -> dbus-secret-service, never async-secret-service. cargo tree --locked --offline --target all -e normal,build,dev -i async-broadcast, with and without --all-features, has no active path. Therefore no current NymWrap process executes this code. Enabling the asynchronous backend, adding a direct dependency or changing keyring features invalidates this exception and requires renewed review. No fixed published release was confirmed: latest checked code retains the problematic operation. Analysis and exact sources: docs/adr/0102-root-dependency-audit-sources.md#root-4-unreachable; evidence in supply-chain/root/review-2026-11-26-batch-4.json. This exception does not audit the rest of the crate.
